hosted.gapReason: Hosted evidence unavailable: no SpacetimeDB credential was present in authorized sources. This is an environment GAP, not a product failure.

commands.label: V1 publish, exact seed, V2 data-preserving migration
React production build and rendered UI smoke

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Caller-scoped subscribed views returned the exact frozen counts for three server-issued identities.
scenarioResults.note: The fresh target contains the exact frozen production-shaped seed and three server-issued development identities.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Mallory received zero protected rows, private subscription was rejected, and two negative writes failed.
scenarioResults.note: Alice owner and Bob team member receive authorized views; Mallory receives no issues, cannot subscribe to the private source table, and cannot mutate.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Server-materialized pages matched authoritative expected IDs for status, assignee, project, and label.
scenarioResults.note: Reducer-side pages select indexed status, assignee, project, or organization candidates and prove label membership by primary-key join.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Two exclusive-cursor 50-row pages retained a 100-row unique union across an earlier-sort insert.
scenarioResults.note: Two server-materialized 50-row cursor pages remain nonduplicating across an insert ordered before the exclusive cursor.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Subscribed related rows supplied exact project, assignee, label, comment, and activity identities.
scenarioResults.note: The subscribed issue detail composes project, assignee, labels, comments, and activity from bounded caller-scoped views.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Application-owned pending state preceded settlement and reconciled to the authoritative revision.
scenarioResults.note: Application-owned optimistic issue state appears before reducer settlement and reconciles to the subscribed authoritative row.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Two actor clients crossed one barrier; one CAS committed, one rejected, and both converged.
scenarioResults.note: A two-actor barrier uses expected-revision compare-and-set: the first serialized reducer commits and the stale contender is rejected.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Bob’s second SDK client observed Alice’s comment and activity via native WebSocket row callbacks.
scenarioResults.note: Bob’s second SDK client receives Alice’s committed comment and activity through native WebSocket view callbacks.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: No native full-text index or service identity exists; no substitute result is claimed.
scenarioResults.note: SpacetimeDB 2.7.0 exposes B-tree/direct indexes and SQL predicates but no ordinary native full-text issue-search index; no client filter is misrepresented as backend search.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Warm memory, empty cold client, disconnected transport, and nonaccepted mutation outcome are retained separately.
scenarioResults.note: The SDK retains an in-memory cache on one disconnected object but supplies neither provider-backed cold persistence nor an offline mutation queue.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Authoritative counts remained 500 before/after while schema proof shows the new defaulted B-tree field.
scenarioResults.note: Republishing added an indexed trailing customerImpact field with a default, retained all 500 seeded issues, and accepted an authoritative post-migration update.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Local identity/config/log/rebuild evidence exists; hosted URL and operations remain unavailable without credentials.
scenarioResults.note: The local deployment identity, schema, configuration, logs, and deterministic rebuild inputs are inspectable; hosted Maincloud deployment is an environment GAP because no credential was available.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Every frozen path retains two warmups, seven raw samples, median, nearest-rank p95, and cost scope.
scenarioResults.note: Two warmups and seven retained samples cover server-materialized lists, composed detail, writes, native realtime, and reconnect; build/deploy samples are added by finalization.

scenarioResults.authoritativeCheck: Exact database lookup failed after delete, both assigned ports closed, and only arm state was removed.
scenarioResults.note: Deleted only the exact fresh arm database, stopped only validated arm processes, proved both assigned ports closed, and removed the worktree-local runtime/credential state.

glue: identity-scoped durable page_result materialization for parameterized cursor pages
application persona registration over server-issued development identities

actor-authority.reason: Three hashed principals, distinct views, a denied private read, and two denied writes are retained.

transaction-conflict.reason: A two-client barrier produced exactly one CAS commit and one rejection followed by convergence.

transport.reason: Native SDK WebSocket row callbacks delivered second-client comment and activity transitions.

offline-reconnect.reason: Reconnect is sampled directly; persistent cold offline state and queueing are explicitly GAP.

settlement.reason: Reducer promises, confirmed reads, revisions, and authoritative subscribed rows bind assertions.

target-identity.reason: Fresh database identity, server, versions, paths, machine, and assigned ports are retained.

cleanup-isolation.reason: Deletion used the exact identity; process commands/cwds were validated; database and ports have negative proofs.

artifact-reproducibility.reason: V1/V2 modules, exact seed, generated bindings, client, harness, locks, raw timings, schema, and inventory are retained.

cleanup.postCleanupProbe: Exact database describe failed after delete; ss reported no listeners on 3320 or 4320; state/ is absent.
